LanguageData.Raven_Building_SlimeBathtub.label: [Raven] Slime Bathtub
LanguageData.Raven_Building_SlimeBathtub.description: A bathtub filled with warm, viscous, specially formulated alchemical slime that perfectly envelops the body of anyone who enters. Ravens enjoy relaxing and killing time in it, as it greatly soothes the nerves after a bath.
